[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ordered-list auto-numbering in the prompt input widget[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The prompt input widget grows and maintains `<N>. ` ordered lists [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]through every keymap that already serves `- ` bullets (Ctrl+J, o, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]O, J, Tab, Shift+Tab), renumbering the surrounding list so its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]numbering is always correct, and colors ordered markers like bullet[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dashes.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared list-marker model and the ordered renumber engine[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: add the pure marker/boundary/ownership primitives shared by both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]marker families, the ordered run scanner, the Prettier-compatible [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renumber engine, and the single-TextEdit list-edit planner; refactor the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hyphen helpers onto the shared primitives with no behavior change.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]INSERT-mode Ctrl+J for ordered items[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]newline[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]newline: route Ctrl+J through the list-edit planner so ordered items [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]continue, split, grow a first sibling, exit from an empty marker, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]de-list at the content column, each as one undo checkpoint with the run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renumbered.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]NORMAL-mode o and O for ordered items[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]openline[dim] · [dim][/dim]after newline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]openline: add an optional planned-edit hook to the vim open-line [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commands so prompt panes open a correctly numbered ordered sibling below[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or above, renumber the run, and keep dot-repeat recomputing at the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]destination.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]INSERT-mode Tab and Shift+Tab nesting for ordered items[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]shift[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]shift: make Tab nest an ordered item under its parent at that parent's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]content column (starting a nested list at 1) and Shift+Tab unnest it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into the enclosing run, renumbering both the source and destination runs[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and moving the item's owned block with it.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]NORMAL-mode J for ordered items[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]join[dim] · [dim][/dim]after openline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]join: drop a pulled-up ordered marker when folding the next line up, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renumber the run the removed item left behind.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ordered-marker highlighting[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]bullet dash already gets, with unit coverage and a PNG snapshot fixture.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
